summary: The size and movement of the U.S. immigration court backlog, from the Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR). National series from EOIR's workload and adjudication statistics: pending cases, new cases, completions, the share of completed cases with a representative on record, asylum decisions and the share of grants among grants and denials, asylum applications pending and pending cases of unaccompanied children, by fiscal year. Pending proceedings by immigration court, by the respondent's state of address and by nationality, counted from EOIR's monthly FOIA case-data file, with the share that has a representative of record. Counts only: no case row, name or address is published, and every cell under 11 is suppressed. Every national table is re-added against its own totals row; the case-data counts are shown beside the published totals and never spliced into them.

records.text: On June 30, 2026, the end of the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, EOIR reported 3,469,569 cases pending in the immigration courts, against 3,722,776 at the end of fiscal year 2025 and 3,924,993 at the end of fiscal year 2024, the highest year-end count in the table from fiscal year 2016.
records.detail: Pending = removal, deportation, exclusion, asylum-only and withholding-only cases, at the end of each fiscal year (the last row is the end of the latest quarter).

records.text: In fiscal year 2025, 55% of completed cases (excluding in absentia orders, terminations and dismissals) had a representative on record: 143,614 of 263,133. The rate was 77% for completed asylum cases, 89% for completed cases of unaccompanied children and 76% for completed appeals.
records.detail: Representation is recorded when a representative of record is noted in EOIR's case system; a person whose representative has not yet filed Form EOIR-28 counts as unrepresented.

records.text: From October 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026, immigration judges issued 254,680 asylum decisions in all: 7,231 grants, 89,740 denials, 92,081 abandonments, 44,062 not adjudicated, 18,251 withdrawn and 3,315 administrative closures.
records.detail: Initial case completions only. Includes affirmative and defensive applications decided in completed proceedings or in proceedings that were administratively closed.
